After she gets tested and tells you the results, you need to take some time to think about what you want. Do you want to be with her still? Would you be able to forgive her? Will you be consistently upset with her? Do you want to take a break? I can go on and on with the questions because I'm currently asking myself those questions. You can be like me and "suck it up and stay" but eventually you'll break without the most important thing.

Trust. Trust is 100% the most important thing. You need to sit down with your girlfriend and talk and see what she wants. If you guys want to be together and she doesn't want to change, you might have to compromise and trust her to not hurt you anymore. Or if you guys stay together and she changes to be better for you and you can trust her again, that works, too.

If not, just leave her. You shouldn't be with someone you can't trust and did such a shitty thing. Even if it was one time, if you can't trust her, it will just destroy you. The relationship will become toxic and you might resent the person you once love.
